Description: Cost-safe AWS development foundation and authenticated admin API for the admintonibover migration.

GuardrailsEvidenceConfirmed.Description: Required acknowledgement that the private issue #3 account, identity, billing, Region, and resource-baseline evidence was rechecked immediately before this change set.

Environment.Description: Issue #7 intentionally permits only the isolated development environment.

AllowedOrigins.ConstraintDescription: Each origin must be one exact HTTPS origin or an HTTP localhost development origin, without paths or wildcards.
AllowedOrigins.Description: Exact admin origins for API Gateway and S3 CORS. HTTP is restricted to local development; do not use wildcards.

CallbackUrls.ConstraintDescription: Each callback must be an exact HTTPS or localhost URL ending in /auth/callback, without wildcards.
CallbackUrls.Description: Exact Cognito authorization-code callback URLs. HTTPS is required except for localhost.

LogoutUrls.ConstraintDescription: Each logout URL must be an exact HTTPS or localhost origin with a trailing slash, without wildcards.

CognitoDomainPrefix.ConstraintDescription: Use a globally unique 3-63 character lowercase prefix containing only letters, numbers, and internal hyphens.
CognitoDomainPrefix.Description: Globally unique prefix for the development Cognito managed-login domain.

EnableTableDeletionProtection.Description: Keep false for the first deployment; update to true immediately after verification. Disable only for the documented dev deletion rehearsal.

Assertions.AssertDescription: Recheck the private account, identity, billing, Region, and resource-baseline evidence from issue #3 before deploying.

Scopes.ScopeDescription: Access to the authenticated admintonibover admin API

Properties.Description: Least-privilege execution role for the issue #7 foundation Lambda.
Authenticated post, taxonomy, backup, and private media operations for the development admin.
